findings.desc: Default-on DONE settlement is implemented and surfaced, but the rollout docs still contain old default-off language: playbook-promotion-worker-execution-plan.md:710-713 says absent/malformed flags are disabled, and source-lineage-dedup-playbook-seed-promotion-execution-plan.md:388-410 says default-on after B-5e28 while still saying the flag is experimental/local-only until later criteria. This leaves the activation/backfill boundary ambiguous even though runtime settlement is learning-only and non-gate.
